identity.title: Protocol for generation, immunophenotyping, and live-cell cytotoxicity analysis of primary human CAR-NK cells using CRISPR-SaCas9 and AAV6.

content.abstract: Targeted gene editing enables controlled integration and consistent expression of a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) in natural killer (NK) cells. We present a protocol for homology-directed repair-mediated CAR knockin into the AAVS1 safe-harbor locus of expanded human NK cells using CRISPR-SaCas9 ribonucleoprotein electroporation and AAV6 donor-template delivery. We also detail the phenotypic analysis of CAR-NK cells using a 23-marker flow cytometry panel including CAR detection and describe a live-cell imaging assay to evaluate CAR-mediated and antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity kinetics.
